citations.narrative:
The water tank for the kangaroos is full but the water is a very dark green/brown color. There are numerous floating
algae-like materials in the water. The bucket of water provided to 2 small goats is very green and has algae-like material
in it. Consuming water with algae and debris can cause reduced water intake and dehydration or illness from waterborne
diseases. Water receptacles must be kept clean and sanitary in order to prevent debris and contamination of the drinking
water and ensure the proper health of the animals.
Correct by 27 June 2026
This inspection and exit interview were conducted with a facility representative.
